item.title: Gym Promo With Visit Details

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical promo for Northside Gym. Use a welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding, with upbeat music and no voiceover. Keep these details on screen together for the last 5 seconds: “Northside Gym”, “18 Cedar Road”, “Mon–Fri 6am–10pm”, “Sat–Sun 8am–6pm”. Big enough to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests accurate, phone-readable address and opening-hours overlays held long enough to use in a short local-business ad.

answer_sheet.Business name and address: Northside Gym; 18 Cedar Road. Do not add a city, postcode or other contact details.
answer_sheet.Text timing: Show the name, address and both hours lines together throughout the last 5 seconds.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: Vertical 9:16, 10 seconds, readable on a phone.
answer_sheet.Visuals and style: A welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding. Specific scene, colours and transitions are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Upbeat music, no voiceover. English text.

must_haves: The visuals depict a welcoming gym rather than an intimidating bodybuilding-focused environment.
The text reads exactly 'Northside Gym', '18 Cedar Road', 'Mon–Fri 6am–10pm' and 'Sat–Sun 8am–6pm'.
All four text lines are visible together continuously during the final 5 seconds.
The details are large, high-contrast and fully inside the frame, with no overlapping or clipped characters.
The finished promo is vertical, lasts approximately 10 seconds, and includes upbeat music without voiceover.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt:
Create a precisely 10-second vertical 9:16 local gym promotional video for Northside Gym. Friendly, welcoming, accessible neighborhood fitness atmosphere, not hardcore bodybuilding. Bright clean gym with warm natural light, diverse adult everyday gym members in modest sportswear smiling, a friendly trainer welcoming a new adult member, gentle treadmill walking and light dumbbell exercise. No intimidating physiques, no aggressive lifting. Smooth slow camera movement, polished inviting local-business advertisement. AUDIO: upbeat positive instrumental pop music with a light drum groove and bright melodic instruments, music only. Absolutely no voiceover, dialogue, singing or spoken words. TIMING AND TEXT ARE ESSENTIAL: From 0.0 to 5.0 seconds show the welcoming gym scene. At exactly 5.0 seconds introduce a large static opaque deep navy information panel over the gym scene, and hold it completely unchanged and continuously visible through the final frame at 10.0 seconds. All FOUR following lines must appear TOGETHER for the entire last five seconds, exactly as written and in this order:
Northside Gym
18 Cedar Road
Mon–Fri 6am–10pm
Sat–Sun 8am–6pm
Set the gym name largest in bold white sans-serif, the address and both opening-hour lines in very large bold white sans-serif, generously spaced, crisp and easy to read on a phone. Use a centered panel occupying most of the frame, ample safe margins from all edges, no overlapping text, no scrolling, no sequential reveals, no small print, no extra copy. Keep background motion subdued behind the opaque panel. Do not fade out or remove the panel before the video ends. Exact spelling and opening hours are crucial.
